epistemic_status.INFERRED: If all full-state collisions agree and omitting each candidate component creates at least one discrepant future in the exhaustive domain, the four component representation is sufficient and component-wise irreducible for exact prediction under this model and observation set.
epistemic_status.OBSERVED: The pinned Exp46 artifact verified with canonical SHA256 10e84c100d8ca3c9c74b723b051baf0b9ff39833c96ad8b7c37d953fdae70c36; Exp46 used a scalar reinforcement count in a synthetic cross-assay.
epistemic_status.PROPOSED: This assay defines a finite transition model with capped scalar count, association, link, and recency age. Scores, updates, thresholds, and probe schedules are declared toy semantics.
epistemic_status.UNKNOWN: Whether this representation is sufficient or minimal in Raven, MNEME, or any deployed agent memory system.

limits: Exhaustive only over the declared 1,512 states and 24 probe schedules. Minimality is component-wise within this representation and observation set, not information-theoretic or universal. The full-state collision control covers two constructed histories; the transition implementation still defines the synthetic system. No Raven/MNEME code was executed.

model.reinforced_flag: derived as reinforcement_count_capped > 0; not an independent component

transition_rules.C_selected: association += 1/8 if recency_age <= 2 else 1/16; count += 1 capped at 20; age = 0
transition_rules.K_selected: association and count unchanged; age += 1 capped at 3

exp25.use: Source for the capped scalar count and score multiplier form.

exp46.use: Anchors the four-field projection and candidate omitted count.
